verdict.rationale: Document QnA combines OCR with an LLM so users can ask questions in natural language and run multi-document comparisons, and bbox annotations accept natural-language requests such as captioning figures. Core operation (OCR options, table format, headers, blocks, confidence scores) is still driven by API parameters and JSON schemas rather than NL commands. One user's attempt to OCR a long document through the Le Chat chat interface stopped after the second page. Missing for 10: NL control of the product's own operations and configuration, a robust conversational interface for large jobs, and independent corroboration of NL-driven workflows.
